description: Add commission system with admin controls. Create commissionTypeEnum, add commission fields to centers table (commissionRate, commissionType, fixedCommissionAmount), add commission tracking fields to bookings table (commissionAmount, commissionStatus, centerEarnings), and create admin API route for setting commission settings per center. Admin center detail page gets commission settings form.
steps: 1. Update db/schema.ts: Create commissionTypeEnum pgEnum with values 'PERCENTAGE' and 'FIXED'
2. Update db/schema.ts: Add to centers table: commissionRate (real, nullable, e.g., 15.0 for 15%), commissionType (commissionTypeEnum, default 'PERCENTAGE'), fixedCommissionAmount (real, nullable)
3. Update db/schema.ts: Create commissionStatusEnum pgEnum with values 'PENDING', 'CALCULATED', 'PAID'
4. Update db/schema.ts: Add to bookings table: commissionAmount (real, nullable), commissionStatus (commissionStatusEnum, default 'PENDING'), centerEarnings (real, nullable)
5. Run 'npm run db:push' to apply schema changes

6. Create app/api/admin/centers/commission/route.ts: PUT endpoint to set commission settings (centerId, commissionRate, commissionType, fixedCommissionAmount). Admin-only using requireAdmin(). Validates: commissionRate 0-100 if PERCENTAGE, fixedCommissionAmount > 0 if FIXED

7. Create app/admin/centers/[id]/page.tsx (new dynamic route): Fetches center by ID, displays center details, includes commission settings form (commissionType select, commissionRate/fixedCommissionAmount inputs), PUTs to /api/admin/centers/commission
8. Update app/admin/centers/page.tsx: Change 'View Details' link to point to /admin/centers/[id] dynamic route
acceptance_criteria: commissionTypeEnum exists with PERCENTAGE and FIXED values
centers table has commissionRate, commissionType, fixedCommissionAmount fields
commissionStatusEnum exists with PENDING, CALCULATED, PAID values
bookings table has commissionAmount, commissionStatus, centerEarnings fields
POST /api/admin/centers/commission validates and updates commission settings (admin-only)
app/admin/centers/[id]/page.tsx exists and displays commission form
Admin can set percentage or fixed commission per center
verification: Run 'npm run db:push' and confirm success
Run 'npm run build' and confirm TypeScript compilation passes
Manually test PUT /api/admin/centers/commission with admin auth, verify database update
Navigate to /admin/centers/[centerId] as admin, verify commission form renders and saves
findings: Implementation completed successfully. All schema changes, API routes, and admin UI components have been created. TypeScript compilation passes without errors. Database push requires manual intervention due to interactive prompts from drizzle-kit about RLS policy column migrations - these need to be confirmed by selecting 'create column' option when prompted. The commission system is ready to use once database schema is pushed manually. Additionally created /api/centers/[id] route to support fetching individual center details for the admin page.
